name: skills-panel
description: A live pane that shows which skills are active, which ones fit your prompt (scored 1 to 10), popular skills you have not installed yet, and which ones you actually use.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane and of the reasons given for each suggestion.

contextMinScore.title: Minimum score shared with Claude
contextMinScore.description: Suggestions at or above this score (1 to 10) are passed to Claude with your prompt.

maxSuggestions.title: Maximum suggestions
maxSuggestions.description: How many suggested skills the pane shows at most.

shareWithClaude.title: Share suggestions with Claude
shareWithClaude.description: Off: the pane still shows suggestions, but Claude does not receive them.

discover.title: Discover skills you have not installed
discover.description: On: after each prompt, 2 to 4 keywords (never the prompt) are sent to skills.sh to list popular skills you do not have yet. Off: no request leaves your machine for this.
